Proves AR-6's `true` unary boolean-filter shorthand. AG Grid core has no dedicated boolean filter type (`iSetFilter.ts` confirms `SetFilterModel` is the only wire shape available for any column type); per the fixture README's documented modeling choice, a boolean column's Set Filter selection is represented as `{filterType:'set', values:['true']}`, which the adapter compiles to the dedicated unary `true` operator (no `value` payload) rather than a generic `eq` against a boolean value.
